entries.text: Security-reviews framework ported to luka-loehr/atlas with CI validation workflow (.github/workflows/security-reviews.yml) and Atlas key redaction patterns.

Completed 4 baseline whole-codebase review runs at d068e6d (architecture/threat-model, service-pentest, quality-maintainability, operations/system-audit): 9 SEC findings, 4 AUD findings, and 5 PASS statements self-verified; 13 fix tasks queued in QUEUE.md.

Completed v0.6.0 delta review (S3, buckets, multipart, IAM, OpenAPI 3.1, revamped CLI), fixed all 14 findings (10 SEC + 4 AUD) across commits 7fa950e, 410e5de, 9caa842, and b62c0a7, confirmed 8 PASS statements, and drained QUEUE.md to 0 open tasks.
